## Usage

Read an explicitly named namespace with independent local or service authority. Playbook grants do not authorize this operator command. Supply a key or snapshot list filters.

See the [durable state guide](../../guides/playbook-state.md) for authority, quotas, protected storage, migration review and failure semantics. The `state_v1` feature remains gated pending D2.

Example command arguments:

```json
{
  "namespace": {
    "scope_kind": "project",
    "scope_owner": "my-project",
    "playbook_id": "my-watch",
    "state_schema_version": 1
  },
  "key": "scan/cursor"
}
```
